name: company
title: Company on five repos
description: This repo as a company's central repo, with customers, strategy, administrative and an intranet beside it: a pipeline of named accounts or population segments, accounts and projects, product, strategy, a decisions journal, and decks and documents refused at build when they fail.
suits: A small company with cofounders who want to steer sales, product and strategy from files, where different people may read different areas. Not for a single project or a one-person organization: one repo does that with less ceremony.

org.description: The GitHub organization that holds the company's repos. It belongs to the company, with two administrators.

name.description: The company's name, as it writes it. It names the intranet's Worker and appears on every page.

profile.description: What the pipeline is made of: b2b-services or b2b-product (named companies) or b2c-product (segments of a population).

extractedFrom: A private kit that set companies up on five repos for several months. It retired on 2026-10-30, and its bootstrap, intranet and recipes became this pack.
